hero.description: Software Engineer specialized in backend systems, distributed architectures, and cloud infrastructure. I design reliable, scalable services from data modeling to the cloud infrastructure that runs them.

about.title: About
about.lead: I enjoy problems where product, code, and infrastructure meet.
about.p1: As a Software Engineer, my focus is on backend systems, distributed architectures, and cloud infrastructure. I have experience building scalable services using Node.js and cloud ecosystems (GCP), prioritizing reliability through microservices and event-driven communication.
about.p2: I complement my technical foundation with strong hands-on experience in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD automation to ensure secure and reproducible deliveries. Regarding the end-to-end product, while my specialty lies in architecting and maintaining the core, I can navigate the front-end to unblock development and ensure the entire integrated flow works seamlessly.
about.p3: I value working in teams that treat software as a long-term product, where technical quality and clear communication are as valuable as speed. This ownership mentality has been with me since co-founding a junior enterprise at university, and continues to drive my day-to-day work building critical platforms.

stack.title: Stack
stack.lead: Technologies I use to build and scale systems.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Selected works across product, cloud, and research.

p1.name: BSS Microservices & Orchestration
p1.summary: Design and implementation of domain-agnostic microservices for a telecommunications platform, using event-driven architecture for scalable and asynchronous processing.

p2.name: Cloud Infrastructure & Automation
p2.summary: Environment provisioning on Google Cloud Platform via Terraform and Pulumi, standardizing multi-tenant deployments and automating CI/CD pipelines for higher reliability.

p3.name: Multi-connectivity in sensor networks
p3.summary: Extension of the IPv6 stack for simultaneous communication across multiple radio interfaces, with duplicate packet handling and higher fault tolerance in low-power devices.

p4.name: Structuring the OctoBit junior enterprise
p4.summary: Creation of the projects directory: scope and requirements processes, technical training tracks, and development team coordination.

e1.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
bullets: Taking technical ownership of core BSS (Business Support Systems) microservices.
Contributing to technical and architectural decisions, ensuring the evolution of scalable, domain-agnostic solutions across the platform.

e2.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented domain-agnostic microservices in Node.js (TypeScript) across core BSS modules, enabling multi-tenant scalability and seamless client onboarding.
Built and maintained cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform and Pulumi, enabling reproducible deployments and standardized environments across tenants.
Architected and launched the platform’s subscription billing module, streamlining recurring payments and complex customer lifecycle management.
Implemented event-driven communication using GCP Pub/Sub, decoupling core services and enabling scalable asynchronous processing across domain pipelines.
Developed CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, automating build, test, and deployment processes to increase delivery speed and software reliability.

e3.title: Student Research Assistant
bullets: Implemented a multi-connectivity framework in C for wireless sensor networks, improving data delivery reliability in high-interference environments.
Designed and implemented an IPv6 extension header for multi-interface communication, enabling duplicate packet handling to reduce packet loss.

e4.title: Co-founder & Project Lead
bullets: Co-founded a student-run software consultancy and structured the engineering delivery process, defining development workflows and project organization.
Led the technical execution of client projects, translating business requirements into software specifications and coordinating development teams.

e5.title: Web Development Intern
bullets: Developed full-stack features for enterprise insurance and healthcare platforms using Java (Spring Boot) and Angular, contributing to large-scale production systems.
Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 10% by auditing AWS resources (Lambda, EC2, S3) and correcting misconfigurations.
Built an internal management tool using NestJS and Next.js to evaluate a new full-stack architecture, enabling its adoption in subsequent client projects.

differentiators.title: Differentiators
differentiators.lead: What I bring to a team.

d1.title: Architecture & Distributed Systems
d1.body: Solid experience in modeling and building microservices, messaging (Pub/Sub), and asynchronous communication designed for resilience and scalability.

d2.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
d2.body: Deep cloud and CI/CD automation. What goes to production is provisioned via Terraform/Pulumi and managed by reliable pipelines.

d3.title: End-to-End Product Vision
d3.body: I understand the complete software lifecycle. While my focus and expertise lie in backend and infrastructure, I can navigate the front-end with ease to integrate APIs and ensure the final product works flawlessly.

d4.title: Solid Foundation & Ownership
d4.body: Computer Science at USP, international research experience in Germany, and a strong sense of ownership sharpened by founding a junior enterprise.
